body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> HTC(www.htc.com) introduced 'EVO Shift 4G' with Android Froyo 2.2 at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6. It has loaded qwerty keypad of slide type unlike the existing products.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
